pas.title: OTB Neural Copy Engine™ · Direct-Response PAS Architecture
pas.prompt:
Role: Principal Direct-Response Copywriter at OTB Agency.
Engine: OTB Neural Copy Engine™ (Direct-Response Protocol v4).
Client Context: MIX Coffee & Mart (Premier Specialty Coffee in Sharkia & Cairo).
Campaign Goal: Meta Ads drive to VIP WhatsApp Concierge for wholesale bean bundles.
Framework: PAS (Problem -> Agitation -> Solution).

Constraints:
1. Opening hook under 7 words. Visceral, sensory, high-curiosity.
2. Tone: Bold, sovereign, refined luxury ("The City Kings").
3. Avoid generic fluff ("Best coffee in town"). Emphasize single-origin Ethiopian beans and precise 93°C extraction.
4. Deliver 3 distinct headline angles and 1 high-urgency call to action linking to WhatsApp.

reel.title: OTB Kinetic Video Synthesizer™ · 15-Second Food Reel Storyboard

Role: Lead Motion Director at OTB Agency.
Engine: OTB Kinetic Video Synthesizer™ (Short-Form Velocity Protocol).
Client Context: Rancho's EG (Gourmet Burgers & Smoked Meats).
Deliverable: Shot-by-shot 15-second kinetic storyboard optimized for 9:16 Reels/TikTok.

Format Requirements:
- 00:00 - 00:03 [The Sensory Hook]: Extreme macro ASMR sizzle + bun press. Text overlay in gold typography.
- 00:03 - 00:08 [The Agitation]: Visual contrast between dry commercial fast-food and juicy slow-smoked beef brisket.
- 00:08 - 00:12 [The Climax]: Melted cheddar cascade with cinematic slow-motion (120fps).
- 00:12 - 00:15 [The Sovereign CTA]: OTB crown lockup + location pin + WhatsApp table reserve.
